question: How must the upper body be positioned when arranging the prescribed seated posture?
premises: The preceding instructions specify the placement of the right and left legs.
The posture is described as endowed with an upright upper body.
The practitioner is enjoined to arrange the seat accordingly.
inference: The prescribed seated posture requires the upper body to be held upright together with the specified leg placement.
uncertainties: The internal structure of āsanoparikalpayet may be parsed as āsana-upari-kalpayet or āsana-upa-parikalpayet.
plain_english: One should arrange the seat with the upper body held upright.
